subject: Pilot keepalive request and one-time waiver for integration pause
messages:
From: Jim Hall <jim@novagrid.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline – integration stall

Marcus,

Thanks for the check-in. We hit an unexpected blocker in our data pipeline when the connector started returning schema nulls; our backend team is tied up with a separate release this week and estimates fix work will slip at least one sprint. Our engineers attached a short error dump and the line-level stack (attached).

Given that the pilot window is tight, can you do a short keepalive — either top-up credits or a one-time extension — so we can finish the integration and run the final validation? If we get the extension we’ll target a soft go/no-go the week after next. We’re still very interested in Redwood, but the timing is now the gating factor.

Appreciate any help you can provide.

—
Jim Hall
CTO, NovaGrid Solutions
jim@novagrid.com
+1 415-555-0122

Attachment: integration_error_log.txt (text)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Jim Hall <jim@novagrid.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline – integration stall

Hi Jim — thanks for the details and the log. Sorry you’re blocked; I kicked this to our integrations playbook and looped in Jordan and Kim who can help diagnose quickly. Two quick asks to help us expedite the internal approval for credits:

- Can you confirm the expected slide (one vs. two weeks) and whether this is a schema mapping or auth/token rotation issue?
- If you have a short screen recording of the failing flow or a minimal repro, that will speed diagnostics.

Internally, I’ll request a short one-time credit waiver to keep the pilot active while your team resolves the bug. Jordan/Kim — can you review the attached log and advise if this looks like an easy connector fix or something that needs engineering time? If it’s a small mapping change we should be able to push a mitigation and greenlight a 10k token top-up; if it’s deeper we may need a different plan.

Jim — I’ll follow up after I speak with our CS and sales ops about the one-time waiver path.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-09-01T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot timeline – integration stall (requesting one-time keepalive waiver)

Team — forwarding Jim's note and the integration log. Quick summary: NovaGrid (RG-3487) is mid-pilot and hit a connector schema nulling issue; they estimate a 1–2 week slip. They asked for either credits or a short extension to maintain momentum.

Proposed recommendation: authorize a one-time 10k token promo and a 14-day pilot extension conditioned on the following:
- Customer provides a minimal repro or screen recording within 48 hours
- Engineering checkpoint: Jordan to confirm whether we can ship a mitigation patch within 5 business days
- Marketing/sales: Marcus to set an updated mutual action plan and communicate the new go/no-go date

Rationale: This is a high-fit account, likely expansion ARR in H2 if the pilot completes. A small promo keeps them engaged and avoids re-provisioning friction.

Requesting Ben's approval on the waiver and Kimberly's sign-off on billing/ops details.

Thanks,
Marcus
